title: Congressman on progress of reverse-engineering programs and the Wilson memo

tellings.quote: Yeah, I do. I just don't think they they're going to scratch- because if they did we wouldn't- we would own the skies if they had it.

plain: An unnamed member of Congress, asked about the Wilson memo, a leaked set of notes said to describe secret programs that study recovered craft, says he believes such efforts exist but have not cracked the technology. His reasoning is that if they had, the US would own the skies.
